# BCGK Communities

> BCGK Communities is a modern property management company built around operational excellence, high standards, and exceptional service.

BCGK Communities manages multifamily apartment communities in California, with offices in Sacramento and Los Angeles. The company operates under California DRE broker license #02416354 and was recognized in Orangevale's 2025 People's Choice Awards as Best Property Management Company and Best New Business.

## Key facts

- Website: https://www.bcgkcommunities.com/
- Phone: (916) 500-0807
- Email: customerservice@bcgkcommunities.com
- Sacramento Office: 1201 J St Ste 200, Sacramento, CA 95814
- Los Angeles Office: 9171 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 500, Beverly Hills, CA 90210
- License: California Department of Real Estate (DRE) broker license #02416354
- Services: multifamily property management, leasing, resident services, maintenance coordination, and owner reporting
- Tagline: Communities Built to Thrive

## Communities managed

- [Almond Heights](https://www.bcgkcommunities.com/property-almond-heights.html) (Auburn, CA, 20 units): Historic Charm. Downtown Living.
- [Lincoln Heights](https://www.bcgkcommunities.com/property-lincoln-heights.html) (Auburn, CA, 16 units): Peaceful Living. Modern Comfort.
- [The Golden Lofts](https://www.bcgkcommunities.com/property-the-golden-lofts.html) (Sacramento, CA, 29 units): Historic Character. Downtown Energy.
- [The Grove Residences](https://www.bcgkcommunities.com/property-the-grove-residences.html) (Orangevale, CA, 50 units): Comfortable Living, Thoughtfully Upgraded.
- [Woodrow Apartments](https://www.bcgkcommunities.com/property-woodrow-apartments.html) (Bakersfield, CA, 5 units): Comfortable Living in Bakersfield

## Frequently asked questions

### How long has BCGK Communities been managing properties in Sacramento?

BCGK Communities has been managing multifamily properties across the greater Sacramento region, building an operating platform focused on disciplined operations and resident experience. Contact our team for the specifics of any individual community.

### What types of properties does BCGK Communities manage?

We manage a range of multifamily communities, from historic downtown buildings and efficiency studios to renovated suburban apartment communities across California.

### Where is BCGK Communities located?

BCGK Communities has two offices: our Sacramento office at 1201 J St Ste 200, Sacramento, CA 95814, and our Los Angeles office at 9171 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 500, Beverly Hills, CA 90210. We manage communities across California, including Sacramento, Auburn, Orangevale, and Bakersfield.

### Is BCGK Communities licensed?

Yes. BCGK Communities operates under California Department of Real Estate (DRE) broker license #02416354. See our Broker Licenses & Disclosures page for details.

### How do I get a quote for property management in Sacramento?

Reach out through our contact form or schedule a call with our team, and we’ll walk through your property’s specifics to build a tailored management proposal.
